semiconductor_relevance: High — Micro-Epsilon provides high precision measurement solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Micro-Epsilon specializes in high precision sensor technology, offering a wide range of sensors for distance, thickness, and temperature measurement tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products are essential in both front-end and back-end processes, ensuring accuracy in wafer handling and photomask positioning.
capabilities: Vacuum ready sensors for distance and thickness measurement
